purpose: Produce a new full manuscript from the minimal story kernel after actual-human approval of the Phase363 Round3 prose engine. This is broad reauthoring, not repair of the rejected V2 prose.
identity_must_preserve: 顾青禾 asks Liu to get 顾承岳 across a legally decisive bridge boundary
Gu is not morally innocent and must ultimately answer for his actions
the promise creates conflict because Liu's loyalty can cost other people
Chinese wuxia suspense direction with commercial page-turn drive and emotional consequence
hard_prohibitions: Do not line-edit or paraphrase the Phase360 V2 manuscript into a new version.
Do not preserve any scene/character/faction merely because an AI previously rated it strong.
Do not use repeated arrival -> explanation -> participation as a middle structure.
Do not use question -> short answer -> follow-up -> short answer / witty tag as the default dialogue engine.
Do not repair dialogue by mechanically inserting generic gestures.
Do not copy or imitate recognizable prose style, wording, characters or plots from reference novels.

mandatory_authoring_method.step_1: Create and freeze a new architecture before drafting prose. Architecture must state retained/cut/merged characters, central suspense chain, scene engines, act-level reader questions, emotional cost curve and climax convergence.
mandatory_authoring_method.step_2: Run a functional-mask check across major scenes so the middle is not a parade of equivalent tactical/social updates.
mandatory_authoring_method.step_3: Draft the full manuscript from the frozen new architecture and story kernel, using the Round3 human-accepted prose engine as a mechanism reference only.
mandatory_authoring_method.step_4: Perform a full-manuscript self-audit for dialogue embodiment, reader propulsion, suspense answer-value, emotional staging, climax voltage, continuity and AI-template recurrence; repair only clear self-detected defects before returning the draft.

prose_engine_requirements: Dialogue is one channel inside continuous action/reaction/perception.
Two spoken lines must not suspend the scene between them.
Important facts should often be inferred, observed, delayed, refused or interrupted rather than systematically asked and answered.
Embodied details must change meaning, pressure, judgment, relationship, timing, distance or choice.
Character-specific relationship is carried through permissions, refusals, coordination, misreadings, habits and physical consequences.
Action pressure may interrupt speech, but action choreography must not erase emotional reading.
No generic frown/glance/sigh/clench-fist tagging as a substitute for scene writing.
structural_requirements: Opening creates attachment/curiosity before system explanation accumulates.
Every retained major character or faction has a distinct dramatic and emotional job; redundant board-state actors are merged or cut.
The middle has escalating causality and page-turn questions, not event accumulation.
Suspense changes a cared-about relationship, trust model, costly choice or safety prediction.
The public-persuasion scene's prior human response may inform protagonist agency/visible consequence, but its rhetoric is not protected.
Climax grows through narrowing options, personal cost and irreversible choice rather than adding combatants.
Ending preserves emotional residue and accountability rather than merely reporting outcomes.
post_completion: Coordinator verifies outputs and new SHA, then runs independent post-change validation before actual human target-reader revalidation.
